name: Hangers and Pants
description:
Three different varieties of hanger and a pair of pants that will hang correctly on any one of them. Hangers are (from front to back) Plastic clothes hanger, old style metal wire coathanger, and velveted hanger.

These hangers are compatible with the [hanging tee-shirt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/hangers-and-tee-shirt-44e260855c7f4c1ca611af8d2370195a), [hanging jumpsuit](https://skfb.ly/pAynE), 
and [this long sleeve shirt](https://skfb.ly/oqqyn), so you can use them interchangably.

Like this model, but need something a bit different? I take commissions! http://peripheralarbor.com/commission/
